cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Converts plain-English process descriptions into validated IEC 61131-3 Structured Text for low-cost ESP32-based PLCs, targeting SME manufacturers in emerging markets who lack access to certified PLC programmers.

test_prompts.prompt: When the conveyor sensor detects a bottle, open the filler valve for exactly 3 seconds, then close it and wait for the next bottle. The valve must be able to re-trigger on every subsequent bottle, so reset the timer after each fill. Read the sensor as an input — never assign a value to it. Declare every timer instance in a VAR block.

Advance the packaging line only while a product is detected at the entry sensor. Stop the line immediately if any of the three safety guards is triggered. Express the line output as a single boolean expression combining the sensor and all three guards, so the result cannot depend on rung execution order. Read all sensors and guards as inputs — never assign values to them.
